title.id: Doa Jika Terlupa Basmallah Diawal Makan
title.en: Supplication when the basmala was forgotten at the start of a meal

translation.id: Dengan menyebut nama Allah, untuk awal dan akhir (makan).
translation.en: In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end.

body.id: Rujukan warisan: HR. Abu Dawud. Catatan ini belum diverifikasi dan bukan sumber terstruktur.
body.en: Legacy citation: HR. Abu Dawud. This note is unverified and is not a structured source reference.

benefits.id: Islam sangat memperhatikan adab, sekiranya anak adam lupa membaca doa makan di awal tetap dianjurkan membaca doa di pertengahan walaupun tersisa sesendok nasi.
benefits.en: Islam gives close attention to manners; when someone forgets the supplication at the beginning of a meal, it is still recommended during the meal, even when little food remains.
